Wild Dagga Vaporization Is the Way to Go
After smoking wild dagga and enjoying it but not enjoying the smoke (I cant really stand smoking much), I read
some claimed that vaporizing produced better results than smoking.
I looked online and found that there is resin sold on a popular online retail site. The resin is weirdly hard and is black. I used a 510 low power atomizer and turned it on while touching a small piece of resin onto the coil to melt it on, after melting it on I placed the cap on and vaporized the resin, the coil was left almost completely clean when the substance was vaporized
T-0:00 Noticed a fast feeling of relaxation
T- 0:02 Feeling a smooth feeling on my body, feeling slightly floaty and light, a small bit of pressure behind my eyes
T-0:05  looked into the mirror, noticed no change in pupil size, but my eye lids were half way closed, still feeling a light body high from earlier, and just a general lift in mood, nothing intense.
T-0:10 Still feeling relaxed and content, I have noticed that it seems my ADHD-derived indecisiveness is gone
T-0:10 Still feeling relaxed and content, I have noticed that it seems my ADHD-derived indecisiveness is gone
d, as I quickly decide what to do next
T-0:15 I am watching Netflix and decide to vaporize another small amount to test to see if I can take this further
T- 0:20 I go back to watching Netflix and playing with my cat, I dont notice any visual distortion as weed does but my body feels warm and I enjoy both activities more than usual l.
T-0:40 I take a break and eat a snack, food tastes exactly the same as usual and music hasnt changed at all
T-1:00 Still content and relaxed
T-1:30 starting to feel tired (it is getting late) so I head to bed
Woke up feeling completely normal, no hangover or sleep interruption
I would  have to call this as a success, its not as strong as weed by a long shot, but can be used as a relaxant/mood improver, I felt 0 anxiety during the experience (unlike weed) and will definitely be doing this again.
I have tried this again with Kratom and found a large amount of synergy as Kratom provides euphoria which adds to the experience and makes it an even more powerful mood booster.
I have tried this in the past with smoking the flowers, and felt similar effects but I had to smoke much more, and the effects didnt last nearly as long.
